title: My kitten Luka's favorite toy is a freaking chip bag clip
author: Janice_M_Audio
authorName: Janice Marie | Sound Designer Open For Work
text: My kitten Luka’s favorite toy is a freaking chip bag clip 😭😭😭
blurb: Forget fancy cat toys: Luka the white kitten has picked a humble chip bag clip as the best toy in the house. Here, Luka creeps out from under the TV stand, eyes locked on the clip lying on the floor, ready to pounce.
